ArtifactKind.description: The teaching artifacts compiled from one LDD.
ArtifactKind.title: ArtifactKind

AssessmentSpec.description: What the author wants: a list of per-type rows plus a retrieval scope.
AssessmentSpec.title: AssessmentSpec

ChatDefaults.description:
A conversation's default retrieval scope. The named fields are the common
tags; ``tags`` carries any other metadata key the corpus uses, so a curator
can filter on fields we didn't anticipate — without a code change.
ChatDefaults.title: ChatDefaults

ChatMessageRequest.description:
A user turn. ``mode`` / ``filters`` override the conversation defaults for
this one message only (the two-modes control); omit to use the defaults.
ChatMessageRequest.title: ChatMessageRequest

CoherenceIssue.description: One cross-day problem found by the coherence pass.
CoherenceIssue.title: CoherenceIssue

CoherenceReport.description: The deterministic arc-quality assessment of a unit (see the coherence pass).
CoherenceReport.title: CoherenceReport

Collection.description:
The v1 grounding collections (see SRD § 06). Each is an independent
logical corpus in the vector store; retrieval queries them by name.
Collection.title: Collection

CorpusIngestRequest.description:
Add/update grounding records in a collection. Each record is a JSONL-style
object (``text`` required; ``grade``/``subject``/``standard``/``language``/
``topic``/``source`` optional). Idempotent: re-submitting the same text
updates the existing point instead of duplicating it.
CorpusIngestRequest.title: CorpusIngestRequest

CoverageReport.description:
How completely a unit plan covers its chapter's syllabus.

``topics`` is the chapter's full, in-order table of contents, enumerated from
the reference book's heading hierarchy (the grounding *outline*), so it is the
real curriculum, not the model's guess; ``gaps`` are the topics the plan
appears to skip. Advisory — surfaced to the teacher so nothing is silently
dropped, never enforced (matching generated topics against headings is
lenient by design).
CoverageReport.title: CoverageReport

CreateConversationRequest.description: The owner is always the authenticated caller — never a request field (D7).
CreateConversationRequest.title: CreateConversationRequest

Critique.description:
A scored assessment of one LDD: per-dimension scores, a weighted overall,
and (optionally) targeted rewrite guidance per weak section.
Critique.title: Critique

DayPlan.description: One day's slot in the unit spine — enough to expand it, not the full lesson.
DayPlan.title: DayPlan

DocumentIngestRequest.description:
Ingest ONE whole document (a book chapter, an exemplar lesson) as raw text,
split by a structure-aware chunker. Unlike the JSONL path (one record → one
chunk), the chunker slices the document and — for ``markdown`` — preserves the
header hierarchy as ``heading_path`` metadata on every chunk.

``chunker`` overrides the per-format default; ``params`` tune it
(``max_chars``, ``min_chars``, ``split_levels``, ``prepend_breadcrumb``,
``include_heading``). Optional ``---`` YAML front-matter in ``text`` is merged
into ``metadata`` (explicit ``metadata`` wins).
DocumentIngestRequest.title: DocumentIngestRequest

DocumentKind.description:
What a stored document holds. ``lesson`` snapshots an LDD; ``unit`` (Phase 4)
snapshots a multi-day unit. The store is agnostic — the kind is metadata for
listing and for choosing how to rehydrate the snapshot.
DocumentKind.title: DocumentKind

DocumentRefineRequest.description:
Refine the current head of a stored lesson. When ``commit`` is true and the
refine succeeds, the accepted candidate is appended as a new ``refine`` version
(with its instruction + diff recorded); otherwise it is only proposed.

examples: make the hook about the local river
instruction.title: Instruction

DocumentRefineRequest.title: DocumentRefineRequest

DocumentRefineResponse.description:
A refine outcome on a stored document; ``version_id`` is set only when the
refine was committed as a new version.
DocumentRefineResponse.title: DocumentRefineResponse

DocumentVersionInfo.description:
A version without its snapshot — what the history list returns (snapshots
are whole lessons/units; listing never needs them).
DocumentVersionInfo.title: DocumentVersionInfo

DocumentView.description: A stored document plus the LDD content at the requested version.
DocumentView.title: DocumentView

FilterMode.description:
The two retrieval modes. ``scoped`` applies the conversation's default tag
filters (grade/subject/class/…); ``broad`` ignores them and searches the
whole corpus. A message may override the conversation default with either.
FilterMode.title: FilterMode

GenerateRequest.description:
A generation request. ``topic`` may be omitted when ``existing_plan`` is
supplied — intake extracts it from the pasted plan (US-3).

examples: Components of Environment: Biotic and Abiotic
topic.title: Topic

GenerateRequest.title: GenerateRequest

GenerateUnitRequest.description:
Plan-and-expand a multi-day unit AND persist it. Adds a title to the unit
request (the owner is always the caller). When ``plan`` is supplied (a
teacher-edited spine from ``/units/plan``) the planner is skipped and that exact
arc is expanded, so edits to the spine actually drive generation.
GenerateUnitRequest.title: GenerateUnitRequest

GroundingPreviewRequest.description:
Inspect what grounding a topic retrieves — the same deterministic retrieval
generation uses — so the UI can show WHICH chunks (and their heading hierarchy)
a lesson is grounded in, without re-running the LLM or quoting the text.
GroundingPreviewRequest.title: GroundingPreviewRequest

Hook.description: Engagement move. Must be a scenario/question, never a definition.
Hook.title: Hook

LearnInputRequest.description:
A learn-mode turn that is not typed text: EITHER an answer to the inline widget
on screen, OR a quick action (hint, example, skip, faster, slower, pause, end,
choose, resume — ``action_value`` carries e.g. the chosen objective id).
LearnInputRequest.title: LearnInputRequest

LessonAssessmentRequest.description:
Build a quiz/worksheet FROM a lesson. ``ldd`` is the lesson as the teacher has
it now (possibly edited and unsaved) — its objectives become the assessment's.
LessonAssessmentRequest.title: LessonAssessmentRequest

NormalizedBrief.description: Output of the intake stage; input to enrichment.
NormalizedBrief.title: NormalizedBrief

PlanResponse.description:
The unit spine plus its syllabus-coverage report, so the preview can show
whether the arc covers every chapter topic before the teacher expands it.
PlanResponse.title: PlanResponse

RefineLessonRequest.description:
Reprompt one section of a lesson. ``ldd`` is the current (possibly already
hand-edited) lesson; ``target`` names the section to improve (or ``"*"`` for
the whole lesson); ``instruction`` is the teacher's free-text intent.

examples: make the hook about the local river
instruction.title: Instruction

RefineLessonRequest.title: RefineLessonRequest

RefineResult.description:
The outcome of one reprompt — a *proposal*, not a mutation.

On success ``ok`` is true, ``candidate`` holds the improved (re-validated) LDD,
``diff`` maps each changed section to its before/after, and ``score_after``
lets the UI show the quality delta. On failure ``ok`` is false, ``candidate``
is ``None``, and ``errors`` explains why (a malformed section, or a coupling
the change would break that the bounded cascade could not repair).
RefineResult.title: RefineResult

RubricScores.description: One score per rubric dimension, each in ``[0, 1]``.
RubricScores.title: RubricScores

SaveLessonRequest.description:
Generate a lesson AND persist it as a new document with its first version.
Adds a title to the generation request; the owner is always the caller.

examples: Components of Environment: Biotic and Abiotic

SavedLesson.description: The result of persisting a generated lesson.
SavedLesson.title: SavedLesson

SavedUnit.description: The result of persisting a generated (or regenerated) unit.
SavedUnit.title: SavedUnit

StartLearningRequest.description: Start a learn-mode session in a conversation.
StartLearningRequest.title: StartLearningRequest

StoredDocument.description:
The document header: identity, ownership, and a pointer to the current
version. The content lives in the versions; this row is what ``list`` returns
and what the head pointer moves over on undo.
StoredDocument.title: StoredDocument

TeacherProfile.description:
A teacher's stored preferences. All fields optional so an empty profile is
valid and simply contributes nothing.
TeacherProfile.title: TeacherProfile

TypeSpec.description: One row of the blueprint: ``count`` questions of ``type`` at ``difficulty``.
TypeSpec.title: TypeSpec

UnitAssessmentRequest.description:
Build a quiz/worksheet FROM a saved unit: ``days`` (1-based; omit for every
day) picks which days' objectives it covers.
UnitAssessmentRequest.title: UnitAssessmentRequest

UnitDesignDocument.description:
A whole unit: its framing, the spine it was expanded from, and the per-day
lessons. Cross-day invariants only — each day's own guardrails live on the LDD.
UnitDesignDocument.title: UnitDesignDocument

UnitPlan.description:
The teacher-reviewable spine produced before any expensive expansion. Small
enough to regenerate cheaply and to eyeball for arc quality.
UnitPlan.title: UnitPlan

UnitRequest.description: Raw input to the unit pipeline: a chapter/topic to spread across N days.
UnitRequest.title: UnitRequest

UnitView.description: A stored unit plus its content at the requested version.
UnitView.title: UnitView

UpdateConversationRequest.description: Partial update: any field left ``None`` is untouched.
UpdateConversationRequest.title: UpdateConversationRequest

ValidationResult.description:
Result of validating an edited LDD before export. Returned with HTTP 200
even when invalid, so the editor UI can render field-level errors inline
rather than treating a normal editing state as a request failure.
ValidationResult.title: ValidationResult

VersionOrigin.description: What produced a version — the audit trail's verb.
VersionOrigin.title: VersionOrigin

Visibility.description:
Who besides the owner may read a document (§17). Sharing is read + copy
only; every write stays owner-only.
